name: shadow_calibrate
description: Refine a Tessera policy with provisional reconstruction error. Reads the existing base policy and the .npz bundles, recomputes the per-tensor reconstruction error under the policy, and emits a refined policy. Used by the shadow-mode calibration loop to test a candidate policy without disrupting the production on-disk state.

layers.description: AWQ bundle directory. Repeat for vision, audio, or drafter bundles.

base_policy.description: Path to the existing base calibration policy JSON.

output.description: Path to the refined policy JSON.

evolver.description: Optional path to the awq-evolve.py (or compatible) evolver binary.

max_tokens.description: Cap on calibration tokens per bundle.

top_fraction.description: Fraction of top-error tensors to focus the refinement on.

max_overrides.description: Cap on the number of override entries written.

residual_boost.description: Multiplier on the per-tensor residual when ranking the refinement targets.
